description: A 20x20 overflow-y: auto frame containing a 40x40 child, at rest (no scroll performed) -- a real browser renders scroll/auto identically to hidden before anything scrolls: the child clips to the frame's own padding box, same as overflow-hidden-clip, with no scrollbar rendered in a headless capture.

florui.css: .frame { width: 20px; height: 20px; overflow-y: auto; } .content { width: 40px; height: 40px; background-color: #ff0000; }

classification.reason: Same anti-aliasing/hinting mismatch already calibrated for overflow-hidden-clip -- this fixture only adds overflow-y: auto in place of hidden, with no scroll ever applied, so it should classify identically.
